decisions.thesis: Bournemouth's positive chance process meets a Brentford side with the stronger form contribution; calibration leaves only a narrow home edge and raises the draw into the same decision zone.
decisions.override_reason: The calibrated home probability leads the draw by only 2.2 percentage points, which activates the locked draw-risk gate.

decisions.thesis: Villa's Player Alpha and finishing-regression case are offset by weak current form and a Forest side that has repeatedly made stronger opponents uncomfortable; the model suppresses the goal environment.

Chelsea own the largest projected-XI Player Alpha advantage on the slate, while Hull's unbeaten scoreline has materially outpaced their underlying chance process; Hull's compact shape limits margin conviction.
Palace hold the Player Alpha and home edge, but both defences have allowed elevated chance quality and Ipswich's latest process improved sharply against Liverpool.
Liverpool's home, form and projected-XI advantages lead the fixture, but Fulham's box pressure can test a Liverpool side whose first two tracked xG performances were weaker than its results.

Tottenham's positive xG-versus-results regression meets Everton's compact direct profile, while neither side owns a strong base fixture signal and Tottenham's lineup projection remains a priority risk.
Sunderland's improved attack faces the league's strongest early defensive process; Arsenal lead both projected-XI Alpha and the opponent-adjusted fixture signal away from home.

Brighton's territorial and Player Alpha advantages are offset by repeated defensive exposure, while Coventry have created more than their zero-goal record implies; calibration leaves the three outcomes tightly grouped.
City's territorial form and projected-XI quality produce the stronger side signal, but United's ceiling, derby variance and the calibrated draw probability prevent a clean position.
Leeds' high-intensity process has produced materially stronger recent xG than Newcastle, whose four tracked goals have outpaced a weak 1.43-xG attacking process.
